scope: One realtime-modules release (0.109.0) batching the presence frame lane, opt-in publish-authorization dedupe (publish proofs) and parseDmLobby/dmLobbyPrefix; both consumers pinned; host adopts proofs + helper; native gates; one readiness-gated burst and one soak on a rebuilt local image. Local only, no cloud.

library.branch: connorhoehn/realtime-modules feat/orgiq-0109 (from 0.108.0 6e2a9392 + perf/presence-frame-lane b365d49c fast-forward); not merged to main, no tag

changes.publishProofs: Opt-in publishProofMaxAgeMs on attachRealtime/LocalRealtimeRouter/RedisRealtimeRouter. Contract P1-P5 written first in src/server-ws/authorityScope.ts: one sender-side publish decision per (clientId, channel) per AuthorityScope; reused only while the scope is active, younger than maxAge (from authorize start) and for the same auth-context object; per-check router fences unchanged; subscribe/recipient checks never shared; host revokes via revokePublishProofs(scope[,channel]); rejections dropped, denials kept. Peers: frame.publisher.proofAt (one number). A peer with its own maxAge > 0 skips only the sender-side publish re-check while now-proofAt <= maxAge and proofAt <= now+250 ms; publisher registration/instance/generation and origin ownership still required; every local recipient still gets a fresh subscribe authorize.

dedupeCounts.localRouterChatSend: publish authorize calls per send 5 -> 1; subscribe calls unchanged (3 for 3 recipients) - test/server/publish-proof.test.ts
dedupeCounts.twoNodeRedisChatSend: origin 7 + peer 1 = 8 -> origin 1 + peer 0; peer subscribe per recipient unchanged (1) - native test/server/redis-router.integration.test.ts against real Redis
dedupeCounts.note: The capacity-latency diagnostics measured ~4.6 publish authorizations per send on loaded fixtures; the 7+1 above is the exact count for one uncontended send through chat + the Redis router. Not re-measured with frames diagnostics in this stage.

gate.jest: 182 suites passed, 1 skipped; 2,097 tests passed, 9 skipped, 0 failed (library-jest.log), with REAL_ROUTER_REDIS against orgiq-cluster-validation-redis via a temporary owned SSH forward (removed); native router 35/35 incl. 5 new, call-recovery Redis 5/5. The two compile failures of the previous stage were a borrowed redis@4 node_modules; this worktree used redis@6.3.0 (the devDependency).
gate.build: rm -rf dist; npm run build (tsc + verify-exports: 31 subpaths) pass; typecheck pass

consumers.pin: middleware + portal package.json -> github:connorhoehn/realtime-modules#d948047cc962fa3d0349a090da27b8f88fd45032, installed 0.109.0 in both
consumers.host: realtime-gateway.ts routerHooks.publishProofMaxAgeMs = REALTIME_PUBLISH_PROOF_MAX_AGE_MS (default 2000, 0 disables, 0-10000); social-chat.ts MirroredMembershipStore.scopedMembers observer calls revokePublishProofs(scope) on a committed write or peer hint; SOCIAL_DM_PREFIX = dmLobbyPrefix, dmMembers/tenantDmMembers via parseDmLobby; portal socialChat.ts DM_PREFIX = dmLobbyPrefix, dmMembers via parseDmLobby. Stricter: an empty member segment (social:dm:a::b) or nested prefix is no longer a DM. Not adopted: SocialChatWorkspace.tsx:250 still slices DM_PREFIX; distillation /realtime router left without proofs.
consumers.residualRisk: A directory epoch/grant revocation is not observed by an event, so a sender's publish proof can outlive it for at most maxAge (2 s) within one send; membership writes and peer hints revoke immediately. Recipient authorization is unaffected.

burst-0109.vsCapacityLatency: chat p95 inside prior plain bursts 2,498-4,336 (lane 2,897-3,302): no improvement beyond noise. Invite p95 1,304 is worse than 0.108 bursts (946-978); single run.

soak-0109.vsCapacityLatency: chat p95 1,610 is below every earlier soak (lane 2,438-3,094; baseline 3,095-13,929) but is one run and still fails 300 ms.
soak-0109.refusals: 120 recipient subscribe refusals on social:dm with a user context, all at one instant on node a, with 22 DynamoDB 'socket did not establish a connection within 2000 ms' errors (conversations index) in the same second: fail-closed authorize on transient store exceptions under overload (the capacity-latency item 3 family), not the shared proof (recipient checks are never shared). 39 messages undelivered vs 2-18 in earlier soaks.

verdict: Capacity remains unaccepted: burst fails invite, chat and both health targets; soak fails chat p95 and both health targets.
